name: Pullman Phuket Panwa Beach Resort
short_description: A 211-room beachfront eco-conscious resort on Cape Panwa with a 4.6/5 ALL rating from around 1,700 reviews.
ai_summary: Pullman Phuket Panwa Beach Resort sits on the palm-fringed shores of Makham Bay on Phuket's southeastern Cape Panwa, about 45 minutes from the airport and 20 minutes from Phuket Town. Its own Accor listing shows a 4.6/5 ALL guest rating from roughly 1,746 reviews, and describes 211 rooms including suites and villas with a private pool, an infinity-edge plunge pool, and marine-life conservation programmes as part of the resort's sustainability focus.

core_facts.address: 44/5 Moo 8 Sakdidesh Road, Vichit Muang, Sub District: Wichit, 83000 Phuket, Thailand

faqs.question: How far is Pullman Phuket Panwa Beach Resort from Phuket airport?
faqs.answer: About 45 minutes by car. The resort is on Cape Panwa in southeastern Phuket, roughly 20 minutes' drive from Phuket Town, on an absolute beachfront setting along Makham Bay with 211 rooms, suites, and private-pool villas that carry a 4.6/5 ALL guest rating from around 1,746 reviews.
